The notice board is read by "facing them and pressing KeyE." The board is at (2,7) — my tile. But maybe the board is actually on a wall and the "at (2,7)" is approximate. Let me try facing each direction and pressing KeyE to read the notice. I already tried up/left/right/down — all "nothing-there". 

Hmm, but "nothing-there: nothing at 2,6" means the game checks the tile I face. The notice board isn't on an adjacent tile. So the board must be ON my tile (2,7). 

Let me reconsider: maybe I'm NOT actually stuck — maybe the position readout is just not updating but I AM moving. Let me observe the player Tester's position relative to me. Player was at (3,7). If I moved right I'd be at (3,7) too. Let me check if player moved.

Actually, let me try a completely different thing: maybe the game needs the key press to be a "press" not "hold" for movement, or maybe there's an input mode issue. Let me try pressing movement as press events.
